2017.description:
The project is about configuring any Data Storage Domain as a new Backup Storage Domain.

  • After setting the storage domain to use for backup, all other storage domain can store their VMs, Templates and disks into it.
  • This feature can be used through REST request or by GUI checkbox available while creating or importing any data storage domain.
  • It is an another step in deprecating the export domain which have few limitations.
